=== Quickstart ===

 ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  Linux Maint ToolKit                                                                                         │
 │  Quickstart                                                                                                  │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing  summary=yes    │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  history=no  logs=no                               │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Current pressure                                  │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  overall=CRIT                                      │
                                                           │  top_reason=http_failed                            │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │  top_problem=network_monitor host=web-2            │
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │
 │  - Use the bootstrap wizard to create config,      │
 │  validate readiness, and preview the first run     │
 │  - Current incident is best after you already      │
 │  have a summary or active failure                  │
 │  - Escalation is most useful once report, JSON,    │
 │  or bundle artifacts exist                         │
 │                                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  first_setup       Guide: first setup and safe first run [f]
  current_incident  Guide: current incident triage [i]
  escalation        Guide: export and escalation workflow [e]
  back              Back to main menu [b]

  Type shortcut or number. ? help, / search, Enter browse, Esc back.

 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │

 │                                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  dashboard   Open: live operations dashboard [d]
  status      Open: current status snapshot [s]
  problems    Review: latest non-OK rows [p]
  report      Review: short operator summary [r]
  trend       Analyze: recent trend (last 10 runs) [t]
  back        Back to main menu [b]

=== Run checks ===

 ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  Linux Maint ToolKit                                                                                         │
 │  Run checks                                                                                                  │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing  summary=yes    │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  history=no  logs=no                               │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Current pressure                                  │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  overall=CRIT                                      │
                                                           │  top_reason=http_failed                            │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │  top_problem=network_monitor host=web-2            │
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │
 │  - Before a live run, create or review config in   │
 │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                      │
 │  - Add targets in                                  │
 │  /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture/servers.txt or       │
 │  under /tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture/hosts.d        │
 │  - Use plan once the inventory is ready            │
 │                                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  run       Execute: run checks now (live output) [r] [changes]
  plan      Preview: resolved run plan only [p]
  wizard    Guide: guided run setup wizard [w]
  back      Back to main menu [b]

  Type shortcut or number. ? help, / search, Enter browse, Esc back.
=== Investigate ===

 ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  Linux Maint ToolKit                                                                                         │
 │  Investigate                                                                                                 │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing  summary=yes    │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  history=no  logs=no                               │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Current pressure                                  │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  overall=CRIT                                      │
                                                           │  top_reason=http_failed                            │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │  top_problem=network_monitor host=web-2            │
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │
 │  - Investigate needs either a summary, a log, or   │
 │  history artifacts                                 │
 │  - summary=yes  logs=no  history=no                │
 │  - Run check and a safe plan first, then come      │
 │  back for drilldown                                │
 │                                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  drilldown   Analyze: filtered status drilldown [d]
  diff        Inspect: changes since previous run [f]
  history     Inspect: recent run history [h]
  logs        Inspect: latest wrapper log [l]
  reasons     Review: top reason tokens [r]
  runtimes    Analyze: slowest monitors [u]
  back        Back to main menu [b]

  Type shortcut or number. ? help, / search, Enter browse, Esc back.
=== Repair ===

 ╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  Linux Maint ToolKit                                                                                         │
 │  Repair                                                                                                      │
 ╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Active context                                    │    │  Fleet status                                      │
 │  mode=repo  overall=CRIT  last_run=missing         │    │  Overall: !! CRIT                                  │
 │  shortcuts=on  preview=on                          │    │  OK:0  WARN:1  CRIT:1  UNKNOWN:0  SKIP:0           │
 │  cfg=/tmp/linux_maint_cfg_fixture                  │    │                                                    │
 │  log=/tmp/linux_maint_menu_render_fixture_probe/l  │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  ogs  state=/tmp/linux_maint_state_fixture         │
 │  config=missing  inventory=missing  summary=yes    │    ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
 │  history=no  logs=no                               │    │                                                    │
 │                                                    │    │  Current pressure                                  │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯    │  overall=CRIT                                      │
                                                           │  top_reason=http_failed                            │
 ╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮    │  top_problem=network_monitor host=web-2            │
 │                                                    │    │                                                    │
 │  Recommended start                                 │    ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │  Recommended first action: first_setup             │
 │  Current triage: connectivity triage: reason       │
 │  explain + focused status + network rerun          │
 │  - Doctor validates deeper dependencies and fixes  │
 │  - Check confirms readiness before the next full   │
 │  run                                               │
 │                                                    │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  incident      Guide: incident response workflow [i]
  focused_run   Execute: focused service and network checks [f]
  check         Validate: config and readiness checks [c]
  doctor        Diagnose: doctor checks and fixes [d] [changes]
  selfcheck     Validate: self-check (safe) [s]
  secprofile    Inspect: strict security profile [p]
  back          Back to main menu [b]

  Type shortcut or number. ? help, / search, Enter browse, Esc back.

  explain_monitor   Explain: one monitor [o]
  explain_status    Explain: status meanings [w]
  config            Inspect: effective config [c]
  settings          Adjust: menu preferences and defaults [s]
  about             Inspect: version and project details [a]
